text: Based on the evidence, the property did not experience deforestation in 2020. While there was a loss of 67.7 ha of trees, the data shows that there was no forest cover present in 2020 according to the JRC GFC2020 dataset. This indicates that the area had already been cleared before 2020 and the loss observed in 2020 was likely the removal of remaining tree cover, not deforestation. The property had some tree cover in 2000, but it had significantly decreased by 2020.
